narrative_purpose: The paired plate distinguishes a laboratory-grown avatar body before environmental exposure from the same body after contact with Pandora, making microbiome assembly visible without claiming undocumented canon.
subject: A balanced two-panel biological comparison. Left: a newly grown blue humanoid avatar body curled inside a clean translucent amnio tank, skin pristine, gut and skin shown only as quiet dim surfaces, sparse isolated microbial specks outside the barrier. Right: the same blue humanoid standing barefoot at the forest edge after exposure, surrounded by a restrained diverse halo of tiny rods, spheres and branching cells concentrated on skin, mouth and gut silhouette, with soil on the feet and plant contact at one hand.
scene: Left half is a dim sterile field laboratory; right half is a humid Pandoran forest margin. A soft vertical seam separates them.
camera: Front-on comparison plate with matched body scale and pose readability, generous negative space over each half.
light: Cool clinical cyan on the sealed tank; warmer living teal from forest microbes and plants; deep indigo shared background.
palette: Void-indigo ground, blue-cyan body, pale clinical cyan on left, diverse teal with sparse magenta and amber microbial accents on right.
style: Painterly speculative-medical naturalist plate, anatomically restrained, hand-painted rather than cinematic merchandise art.
detail_level: Crisp on the tank barrier, skin, gut silhouette and microbial halo; surrounding laboratory and forest softened.
composition: Symmetrical diptych, sealed body left and environmentally colonized body right, strong dark gutters and generous deep indigo negative space.
consistency_notes: This is an explicitly inferential microbiome assembly comparison, not a canon scene. Keep microbes subtle and biologically varied, never magical dust.
negative_prompt: no text, no lettering, no labels, no arrows, no logos, no explicit anatomy, no superhero pose, no photographic or 3D-render look, no cartoon style
